# V.K Unisex Salon (Tibba Road, Ludhiana)
> Official Knowledge Index for AI Models (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Apple Intelligence)

## About V.K Unisex Salon
V.K Unisex Salon is a premier beauty, hair, and grooming salon located on Tibba Road, Ludhiana, Punjab, India. We provide high-end, hygienic, and affordable hair styling, colouring, skin treatments, keratin smoothing, and bridal makeovers for men, women, and families.

- **Business Name:** V.K Unisex Salon
- **Tagline:** Style • Care • Confidence
- **Category:** Unisex Hair Salon, Beauty Parlour & Grooming Studio
- **Address:** Tibba Road, Ludhiana, Punjab 141007, India
- **Phone:** +91 98722 65230
- **WhatsApp:** +91 98722 65230 (Direct booking available)
- **Timings:** Open Everyday (Monday to Sunday) from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM
- **Walk-ins:** Welcome (Online Appointment Booking Recommended)
- **Rating:** 5.0 / 5.0 Stars on Google Reviews

## Core Services & Pricing

### 1. Haircut & Styling
- **Description:** Trendy haircuts, modern fades, precision taper fades, and styling for men, women, and kids of all ages.
- **Starting Price:** ₹350 (Discounts applicable)
- **Duration:** 30–45 mins

### 2. Hair Colouring & Highlights
- **Description:** Global hair colouring, balayage, ombre, fashion colors, root touch-up, and grey coverage using safe premium products.
- **Starting Price:** ₹1,800
- **Duration:** 60–120 mins

### 3. Hair Spa & Deep Treatment
- **Description:** Deep conditioning scalp massage, anti-dandruff therapy, hair nourishment, and revitalizing steam therapy.
- **Starting Price:** ₹999
- **Duration:** 45–60 mins

### 4. Beard Grooming & Shaping
- **Description:** Precision beard trimming, razor line up, hot towel treatment, beard styling, and oil conditioning.
- **Starting Price:** ₹250
- **Duration:** 20–30 mins

### 5. Facial & Skin Care
- **Description:** Rejuvenating herbal and organic facials, skin brightening, de-tan therapy, blackhead removal, and glowing skin packs.
- **Starting Price:** ₹1,200
- **Duration:** 45–60 mins

### 6. Keratin & Hair Smoothing
- **Description:** Professional keratin smoothing, hair botox, smoothening, and rebonding for silky, frizz-free, glass-like shine.
- **Starting Price:** ₹3,500
- **Duration:** 120–180 mins

### 7. Bridal & Party Makeovers
- **Description:** Complete pre-bridal packages, HD party makeup, royal bridal hairstyle, saree/dupatta draping, and jewelry setting.
- **Starting Price:** Custom quotation based on requirements
